name: Evaluations
description: Tests whether the eval framework accepts a BYOM-prefixed deployment_name for the judge model. Research suggests it likely does NOT parse the prefix (same posture as image-generation-direct).
notes:
Judge-model BYOM is blocked by the eval SDK URL-shape bug.

Verified on `ai-foundry-63fhh7glaqhvw` with `azure-ai-evaluation`: the SDK constructs `/openai/deployments/{apim-conn}/{model}/chat/completions`, which Foundry does not route, returning `400 'API version not supported'`.

Requires eval-SDK changes or a Foundry URL rewrite. Skips if `EVAL_JUDGE_MODEL` is unset.
